manifest.gpu:
name, memory.total [MiB], driver_version
NVIDIA H20, 97871 MiB, 535.161.08
manifest.notes: Sustained closed-loop traffic with at most C client requests in flight. Throughput includes admitted requests' drain time; cache counters cover the whole window and post-request drain. Prepared-prefix output comparisons are diagnostic, not batch-invariant correctness proofs. Memory peaks are sampled lower bounds.

timeline.notes: Durations use one process's monotonic clock or Manager-local elapsed_us. Engine callback observations are not GPU kernel timestamps. Missing stages are not zero latency.

storage.notes: Device inventory does not prove which physical disk backs an overlay mount.
